center.title: Delivery Pilot
center.statement: Be early to the disruption, retool people for it, and help them become Delivery Pilots, people who deliver with AI, by creating and learning with high tech in public.

circles.label: What I love
items: Early disruption: being early to the next big shift
AI and human intelligence: how both think and learn
Building software: 612 GitHub repos of solutions I came up with and built
Learning by myself through video, and asking questions passionately
Creating and learning with high tech
Watching high-tech videos where I learn something new (a proud geek)
Physics, space and the big frontier questions
Games, especially real-time strategy like Command & Conquer
Stand-up comedy and improvisation
Inspiring stories, and believing the future is bright
Music scored to emotion: soundtracks that move you

circles.label: What I'm good at
items: Projects: getting them over the line
Delivery: 40+ contracts delivered across 8 countries
Reinventing myself: tutoring → real estate → brokering → coding → DevOps → SRE → AI

circles.label: What I get paid for
items: Migration contracts

circles.label: What the world needs
items: Retooling: people re-skilled for the AI shift, not left behind
Skilling up as AI raises the bar
The courage to become a pilot, a Delivery Pilot who delivers with AI
Hope: a future that's bright and believable, not hype

overlaps.label: Passion
overlaps.text: Building new high-tech projects and seeing them through.
overlaps.content: Hands-on builds with the newest tools: Pillar 1. Your energy shows when you're building, so film that.

overlaps.label: Mission
overlaps.text: Learning new tech in public so others can skill up too.
overlaps.content: Self-learning videos, the free Delivery Pilot course for students, and the 'I never finished university' story.

overlaps.label: Profession
overlaps.content: Migration case studies as proof: 'how I'd migrate X with AI agents', the real delivery that gives Pillar 2 its credibility.

overlaps.label: Vocation
overlaps.text: Retooling people and teams to deliver with AI: the Delivery Pilot role.
overlaps.content: Skool community and course, plus businesses buying builds and services (the B2C2B audience).

games.title: 🎮 Games (real-time strategy): the love that isn't on the channel yet
games.text: You love games, especially real-time strategy like Command & Conquer, and it's the one love with no home in your content yet. RTS is almost exactly the Delivery Pilot job: command units from above, manage resources, scout the unknown. It fits naturally:
ideas: 'Running AI agents is a real-time strategy game': you command units (agents), manage resources (tokens and cost), scout the fog of war (unknowns), and build the base (infra). Use your own visuals, not game footage.
Skool gamification: points, levels and 'pilot ranks' (Rider → Driver → Pilot) for members who ship
The Pilot's Log sci-fi series (Formats page): missions and episodes are game structure
'Speedrun' Shorts: build X with a cheap model in under 60 seconds, against the clock
Build a tiny browser game with AI agents live, which is new tech, games and delivery in one video

channel: 🎯 Every video should sit in at least two circles. The best (the centre) sits in all four.
🧪 Mindset Shorts fail because they're only 'world needs'. There's no love, skill or proof showing.
🏆 Your best videos already sit near the centre: practical builds (love + good) for career outcomes (need + paid).

dream.title: 🌠 The long-range mission
dream.text: Solve interstellar travel and work on physics. It's the furthest horizon, and it's why the pilot metaphor is more than a metaphor for you.
channel: The Pilot's Log sci-fi series (Formats) gives the dream a home on the channel today
'What would it take to reach another star?' as a data-backed big-picture video (Pillar 2)
Physics explainers using AI tools: learning in public on the hardest subject there is

inspirations.name: Elon Musk
inspirations.take: First-principles thinking, very ambitious missions, and space as a real goal.
inspirations.channel: Bold missions in titles and series. Stay data-backed and contrarian where the evidence says so (your 'Elon Says Work Is Ending. The Data Says Otherwise.' got 348 views).

inspirations.name: Susan Boyle
inspirations.take: The underdog moment: underestimated on sight, then the voice changes the room.
inspirations.channel: Your story has the same shape: no degree, a new country, then delivery that speaks for itself. Use the 'reveal' structure in story videos.

inspirations.name: Max Amini
inspirations.take: Improvised, warm, multicultural stand-up: crowd work that makes everyone feel included.
inspirations.channel: Comedy sketches and improv in Skool Lives. Your Turkish, US and British life is full of warm, real material.

inspirations.name: Tony Robbins
inspirations.take: Energy, state and belief: people change when they believe they can.
inspirations.channel: End videos with a clear, confident call to action and optimism, backed by a plan (like the 90-day flight plan), not just hype.

drains.title: 🪫 What drains me
items: Non-agentic work: debugging syntax issues by hand
Repetitive fixes that a machine should do
drains.insight: This is the Delivery Pilot thesis in your own life: hand syntax and lint to agents, and keep the judgment, the spec and the delivery.
